title: Search Errors in Logs
description: Search application logs for common error patterns.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG_FILE="${1:-/var/log/syslog}"

if [[ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: File not found: $LOG_FILE" >&2
    exit 1
fi

grep -Ein 'error|failed|fatal|critical|exception' "$LOG_FILE" | tail -50 || true
